text: There's an assistant for everything now. But each one works alone, in its own silo.
So you become the relay: copying tasks between chats, passing messages along, and reviewing every result yourself.
Sensei Relay connects them. One assistant registers as the controller; the rest join as contributors.
The controller turns your goal into a plan, hands out the tasks, and every contributor reports back.
Contributors review each other's work against the requirement. Results are merged, and a metrics gate decides when the goal is met.
Leave and rejoin, hand over control. Sensei Relay: many assistants, one goal, delivered reliably.
